title: Firm Credit Constraints and Electronic Payments: A Global Analysis
affiliations: World Bank - Research Department, affiliation not provided to SSRN and World Bank

detail.title: Firm Credit Constraints and Electronic Payments: A Global Analysis
detail.abstract: Understanding the drivers of credit constraints is essential for fostering private sector development and firm growth. In this study, we examine the channels through which electronic payments influence firm credit constraints across 115 economies. We explore heterogeneity at both the firm and aggregate levels to identify key policy and environmental factors that shape this relationship. Our findings indicate that payment digitalization plays a critical role in alleviating firm credit constraints, particularly for informationally opaque firms and in economies with weaker credit infrastructure and lower levels of financial development. These results support the view that electronic payments help reduce information asymmetries between firms and lenders, thereby improving lending opportunities.

AI.tldr: 本研究利用115个经济体的数据，发现电子支付通过缓解信息不对称，显著降低了企业（尤其是信息不透明企业）的信贷约束，且在信贷基础设施薄弱、金融发展水平较低的经济体中效果更明显。
AI.research_question: 电子支付通过哪些渠道影响企业信贷约束？不同企业和经济体层面的异质性如何？
AI.motivation: 理解信贷约束的驱动因素对促进私营部门发展和企业增长至关重要，但电子支付如何影响企业融资约束的机制尚不明确。
AI.theoretical_framework: 信息不对称理论：电子支付产生的数字化交易记录降低了企业与贷款人之间的信息不对称，从而改善信贷可得性。
AI.method: 覆盖115个经济体的跨国数据，采用企业层面和宏观层面的异质性分析。
AI.findings: （1）支付数字化显著缓解企业信贷约束；（2）对信息不透明的企业效果更强；（3）在信贷基础设施薄弱、金融发展水平较低的经济体中作用更显著。
AI.theory_contributions: 验证并拓展了电子支付通过减少信息不对称缓解信贷约束的理论机制，揭示了企业和经济异质性的边界条件。
AI.practical_contributions: 为政策制定者推动支付数字化以缓解企业融资难提供实证依据，尤其对金融欠发达地区具有重要政策启示。

title: Beyond Critical Success Factors: Explaining Software Project Success with Explainable AI and Causal Discovery through Success Propagation in Global Software Development
affiliations: Lebanese American University, Lebanese American University, Lebanese American University and Lebanese American University

detail.title: Beyond Critical Success Factors: Explaining Software Project Success with Explainable AI and Causal Discovery through Success Propagation in Global Software Development
detail.abstract: Software project success has traditionally been explained through lists of Critical Success Factors (CSFs). The increasing availability of software repository data and advances in explainable artificial intelligence (XAI) provide opportunities to move beyond factor identification toward understanding the mechanisms through which success is generated in Global Software Development (GSD) environments. This study aims to develop and evaluate Success Propagation Theory (SPT), a novel framework that conceptualizes software project success as an emergent ecosystem phenomenon generated through interconnected propagation pathways. Specifically, the study seeks to identify the primary drivers of project success, uncover causal relationships among repository-derived project constructs, and explain how success propagates across software-development ecosystems.A repository-month panel dataset comprising 656 observations from 13 real cloud-native software projects was analyzed. Repository-derived metrics were transformed into constructs representing Communication Effectiveness (COM), Coordination Quality (COORD), Development Intensity (DEV), Project Management Efficiency (PM), Quality and Risk Management (Q), Leadership Engagement (LEAD), and the Global Software Development Success Index (GSDSI). A multi-method analytical framework integrating Random Forest, XGBoost, SHAP-based explainable AI, LiNGAM causal discovery, and network analysis was used to identify causal pathways, and ecosystem influence structures. Development Intensity emerged as the strongest predictor of project success, accounting for 35.6% of total predictive importance, followed by Leadership Engagement (19.1%) and Project Management Efficiency (18.5%). Causal-discovery and network analyses revealed structured propagation pathways that contribute to project success. By integrating explainable AI, causal discovery, and repository analytics, the research demonstrates that project success emerges through interconnected socio-technical mechanisms rather than isolated factors.

AI.tldr: 本研究提出并验证了"成功传播理论"（SPT），将软件项目成功视为通过互连传播路径产生的生态系统现象。基于13个云原生软件项目的656个观测数据，结合随机森林、XGBoost、SHAP可解释AI、LiNGAM因果发现和网络分析，发现开发强度（35.6%）、领导参与（19.1%）和项目管理效率（18.5%）是成功的主要预测因子，揭示了成功通过结构化社会技术机制传播的路径。
AI.research_question: 在全球软件开发（GSD）环境中，项目成功是如何通过互联的传播路径作为生态系统现象生成的？哪些是项目成功的主要驱动因素，它们之间的因果关系如何？
AI.motivation: 传统的关键成功因素（CSFs）方法仅列举因素，未能揭示成功生成的机制。软件仓库数据的日益可及和可解释人工智能（XAI）的进步，为超越因素识别、理解成功在GSD环境中的生成机制提供了新的机会。
AI.theoretical_framework: 成功传播理论（Success Propagation Theory, SPT），将软件项目成功视为通过互联传播路径生成的涌现生态系统现象。
AI.method: 构建包含656个观测值的仓库-月面板数据集（13个云原生项目），将仓库度量转化为七个构念（沟通有效性、协调质量、开发强度、项目管理效率、质量与风险管理、领导参与、GSD成功指数）。采用多方法分析框架：随机森林、XGBoost、SHAP可解释AI、LiNGAM因果发现、网络分析。
AI.findings: 开发强度是项目成功的最强预测因子（35.6%），其次是领导参与（19.1%）和项目管理效率（18.5%）。因果发现和网络分析揭示了结构化的成功传播路径。项目成功通过互联的社会技术机制产生，而非孤立因素。
AI.theory_contributions: 提出了成功传播理论（SPT），将项目成功的概念从静态因素列表转变为动态、互联的生态系统现象；通过因果发现揭示了成功传播的结构化路径。
AI.practical_contributions: 为GSD项目管理者提供了可操作的重点领域（开发强度、领导参与、项目管理效率）；展示了如何利用仓库数据和可解释AI进行项目成功预测和诊断。

title: From Data to Action: Accelerating Refinery Optimization with AI
affiliations: Budapest University of Technology and Economics, Budapest University of Technology and Economics, MOL Group, MOL Group, MOL Group, Budapest University of Technology and Economics and Budapest University of Technology and Economics

detail.title: From Data to Action: Accelerating Refinery Optimization with AI
detail.abstract: Nowadays refinery optimization utilizes sheer amounts of data, which can be handled with modern Linear Programming (LP) software, but the interpreting and applying the results remains challenging. Large petrochemical companies use massive models, with hundreds of thousands of input matrix elements. The LP solution is mathematically correct, but simplifications are made in the model, and data supply errors may occur. Therefore, further insight is needed to trust the results. The LP solver does not have a memory, so additional understanding could be gained by analyzing historical data and comparing it to the current plan. As such, machine learning approaches were suggested to support decision making based on the LP solution. Among these, Anomaly Detection tools are proposed to be used in tandem with the LP output. A transformed version of the popular ECOD methodology is applied. New methods are proposed to handle high-dimensional data: choosing the most informative pairs. Then, this is used alongside two 2D Anomaly Detection algorithms, revealing several business opportunities and data supply errors in the MOL refinery scheduling and planning architecture.

AI.tldr: 本文提出将异常检测（尤其是改进的ECOD方法）与线性规划（LP）输出结合使用，通过分析高维历史数据与当前计划，帮助炼油企业发现数据供应错误和商业机会，增强对LP优化结果的信任。
AI.research_question: 如何通过异常检测方法增强对炼油厂线性规划（LP）优化结果的解释和信任，并识别数据供应错误与商业机会？
AI.motivation: 炼油厂优化依赖大规模LP模型，但模型简化与数据错误可能导致结果不可信；LP求解器无记忆能力，无法利用历史数据提供额外洞察。
AI.theoretical_framework: 线性规划（LP）优化理论；异常检测理论（ECOD方法及其改进）；高维数据降维与成对特征选择方法。
AI.method: 对经典ECOD方法进行变换，提出高维数据中最具信息量的特征对选择方法，结合两种二维异常检测算法，在MOL炼油厂的调度与计划架构中进行应用验证。
AI.findings: 该方法成功识别了多个商业机会和数据供应错误，验证了异常检测与LP输出相结合的有效性。
AI.theory_contributions: 提出了适用于高维炼油数据的异常检测改进方法（变换版ECOD），以及选择最有信息量特征对的新策略，拓展了异常检测在工业优化中的应用边界。
AI.practical_contributions: 为大型炼油企业提供了一种可落地的决策支持工具，帮助发现数据错误与优化机会，提升LP结果的可信度与实用性。

title: Two-layer Optimization Model for RERs and ESSs Optimal Configurations in the Modified Manjil MG
affiliations: affiliation not provided to SSRN

detail.title: Two-layer Optimization Model for RERs and ESSs Optimal Configurations in the Modified Manjil MG
detail.abstract: Optimal configurations of RERs and ESSs in MG has multiple planning and operating benefits for MG; such as, less investment cost with more rate of return (IRR), better operating conditions, reduction of carbon emissions, less purchased power from main power grid, and sustainability improvement. These advantages will be more notable when these optimal configurations are accompanied by the MG load management. To achieve these aims, simultaneous optimization of RERs and ESSs configurations in the MG planning and operation is required.This paper proposes a two-layer model to optimize RERs and ESSs configurations in the modified Manjil MG. The model is based on generation-load balance, storage enhancement, and electric power constraints. The carbon trading and time-sharing tariff mechanisms are added to this model. The Photovoltaic (PV) and wind power (WP) generations as two main DERs are attended in this model. The upper-layer optimization model is for maximizing the MG annual planning profits and the lower-layer model minimizes the MG daily operation costs. The upper and lower models are respectively solved using the PSO and CPLEX solvers in an integrated optimization algorithm. The results show that, optimal configurations of RERs and ESSs in this MG significantly improves both overall economic efficiency and operation parameters of it. So that, annual power purchase cost is reduced, the financial net present value (NPV) of the MG and the annual income from carbon trading are increased. Also, the investment costs return period of the RERs and ESSs will be shortened, with maximum internal IRR.

AI.tldr: 本文提出一种双层优化模型，用于微电网中可再生能源和储能系统的最优配置，结合碳交易和分时电价机制，显著提升了微电网的经济效益和运行性能。
AI.research_question: 如何在微电网规划与运行中同时优化可再生能源（光伏、风电）和储能系统的配置，以最大化经济效益并改善运行参数？
AI.motivation: 微电网中可再生能源和储能系统的最优配置能带来投资成本降低、碳减排、购电成本减少等多重收益，且结合负荷管理效果更显著。现有研究缺乏同时考虑双层优化、碳交易机制和分时电价的综合模型。
AI.theoretical_framework: 双层优化理论、生成-负荷平衡理论、碳交易机制、分时电价机制、PSO算法、CPLEX求解器
AI.method: 构建双层优化模型：上层使用PSO算法最大化微电网年规划利润，下层使用CPLEX求解器最小化日运行成本。模型考虑发电-负荷平衡、储能约束和电力约束，并引入碳交易和分时电价机制。
AI.findings: 最优配置显著改善经济效率和运行参数：年购电成本降低，NPV和碳交易年收入增加，投资回收期缩短，内部收益率最大化。
AI.theory_contributions: 提出了将碳交易机制与分时电价机制同时纳入微电网双层优化配置的理论框架，丰富了微电网规划与运行协同优化的理论体系。
AI.practical_contributions: 为微电网运营商提供了可操作的双层优化配置方法，有助于降低投资成本、缩短回收期、增加碳交易收入，提升微电网整体经济效益和可持续性。

title: Exploring Light-Weight Data-Driven Framework for Battery Degradation Mode Quantification in Practical
affiliations: affiliation not provided to SSRN, affiliation not provided to SSRN, affiliation not provided to SSRN, affiliation not provided to SSRN, affiliation not provided to SSRN and affiliation not provided to SSRN

detail.title: Exploring Light-Weight Data-Driven Framework for Battery Degradation Mode Quantification in Practical
detail.abstract: The aging behavior of Li-ion batteries influences battery degradation modes, leading to accelerated capacity loss and potential safety issues. Quantifying these degradation modes poses challenges for both online and offline diagnostics in charging station applications. Data-driven algorithms have emerged as effective tools for addressing state-of-health issues by learning hard-to-model electrochemical properties from data. This paper presents a data-driven framework for quantifying battery degradation modes in practical. Ninety statistical features are extracted from the incremental capacity curve derived from practical non-OCV charging data. These features are then screened based on dispersion, contribution, and correlation. Subsequently, machine learning models, including four surrogate algorithms and a feedforward neural network, are used to estimate the degradation modes. Experimental validation indicates that the feedforward neural network outperforms the others, achieving a mean absolute percentage error below 10\% across all three degradation modes (i.e., loss of lithium inventory, loss of active material on the positive electrode, and loss of active material on the negative electrode). The findings in this paper demonstrate the potential of machine learning for diagnosing battery degradation modes in real-world charging scenarios.

AI.tldr: 本文提出一个数据驱动框架，从实际充电数据的增量容量曲线中提取90个统计特征，通过筛选后使用机器学习模型（前馈神经网络最佳）量化锂电池的三种退化模式（LLI、LAM_PE、LAM_NE），在实验中MAPE低于10%。
AI.research_question: 如何利用数据驱动方法从实际非OCV充电数据中量化锂离子电池的退化模式？
AI.motivation: 锂离子电池老化行为影响退化模式，导致容量加速衰减和安全问题。但目前在线和离线诊断在充电站应用中难以量化这些退化模式。
AI.theoretical_framework: 增量容量分析（ICA）、统计特征提取与筛选、机器学习回归（前馈神经网络、多种替代算法）。
AI.method: 从实际充电数据的IC曲线中提取90个统计特征，基于离散度、贡献度和相关性筛选特征，用四种替代算法和FFNN估计退化模式，通过实验验证模型性能。
AI.findings: 前馈神经网络优于其他模型，三种退化模式（锂库存损失、正极活性物质损失、负极活性物质损失）的MAPE均低于10%。
AI.theory_contributions: 将数据驱动特征筛选与机器学习相结合，实现了从实际非OCV充电数据中对多种电池退化模式的同时量化诊断。
AI.practical_contributions: 为充电站场景下的电池退化模式在线诊断提供了可行且高精度的解决方案，便于实际应用中的电池健康管理。

title: From Discrete to Continuous LoRa Parameter Estimation Using Vision-Based Deep Learning
affiliations: affiliation not provided to SSRN and affiliation not provided to SSRN

detail.title: From Discrete to Continuous LoRa Parameter Estimation Using Vision-Based Deep Learning
detail.abstract: Building on a vision-based deep learning method for Long Range (LoRa) radio signal classification in spectrogram images, we evaluate two strategies for continuous non-standard parameter estimation: geometric postprocessing of spreading factor (SF) derived from nominal You Only Look Once (YOLO) class predictions, and direct use of scale-augmented YOLO predictions. Results show that YOLO generalizes beyond discrete training anchors and accurately recognizes spreading factors for non-standard bandwidths without postprocessing; geometric correction provided no additional SF benefit. The proposed pipeline achieves 3.48% RMSRE for continuous bandwidth estimation, 97.50% bandwidth accuracy within the defined tolerance, and 98.50% exact-match SF accuracy. We further introduce a diagonal Sobel transform at the input stage, which better exploits YOLO's 3-channel architecture by emphasizing LoRa-specific diagonal gradients and yields a 1.3 percentage-point gain in mAP50-95. In addition, we extend the set of identifiable parameters by detecting chirp direction. Together, these outputs provide a more complete LoRa signal profile for discovering IoT uplink transmissions and radio-control links for drones, planes, and other vehicles. Multiscale benchmarking shows that the smallest YOLO nano variant evaluated at 256x256 spectrograms reaches 67.57% mAP50-95, supporting deployment on resource-constrained edge devices. ​

AI.tldr: 本文基于YOLO深度学习模型，在频谱图图像上对LoRa无线电信号进行分类和连续非标准参数估计，实现了高精度的扩频因子识别和带宽估计，并引入对角Sobel变换提升性能，支持边缘设备部署。
AI.research_question: 如何利用基于视觉的深度学习方法（YOLO）实现LoRa无线电信号的连续非标准参数估计（扩频因子、带宽等）？
AI.motivation: LoRa信号在物联网和无人机、飞机等无线电控制链路中广泛应用，但现有方法对非标准参数的连续估计能力不足，需要更完整的信号特征提取方案。
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于YOLO的目标检测与分类架构；频谱图图像处理；几何后处理与尺度增强预测；对角Sobel变换用于特征增强。
AI.method: 采用YOLO对LoRa频谱图进行目标检测；对比几何后处理与尺度增强YOLO直接预测两种策略；引入对角Sobel变换优化3通道输入；扩展参数集以检测线性调频方向。
AI.findings: YOLO可泛化至离散训练锚点之外，无需后处理即能准确识别非标准带宽下的扩频因子；带宽连续估计RMSRE为3.48%，带宽准确率97.50%，SF精确匹配准确率98.50%；对角Sobel变换使mAP50-95提升1.3个百分点；最小YOLO nano变体在256x256频谱图上达到67.57% mAP50-95。
AI.theory_contributions: 证明了YOLO在无线电信号频谱图分类中可超越离散锚点泛化；验证了尺度增强YOLO直接预测优于几何后处理策略；引入对角Sobel变换作为适应LoRa信号特征的输入预处理方法。
AI.practical_contributions: 实现了非标准LoRa参数的连续高精度估计，可用于物联网上行链路和无人机等无线电控制链路的发现；小型化YOLO nano变体可在资源受限的边缘设备上部署，具有实际应用价值。

title: A Geometric Probe of the Accuracy-Robustness Trade-off: Sharp Boundaries in Symmetry-Breaking Dimensional Expansion
affiliations: Northwest Institute of Nuclear Technology, Northwest Institute of Nuclear Technology, Northwest Institute of Nuclear Technology, Northwest Institute of Nuclear Technology, Northwest Institute of Nuclear Technology and Northwest Institute of Nuclear Technology

detail.title: A Geometric Probe of the Accuracy-Robustness Trade-off: Sharp Boundaries in Symmetry-Breaking Dimensional Expansion
detail.abstract: The trade-off between clean accuracy and adversarial robustness is a pervasive phenomenon in deep learning, yet its geometric origin remains elusive. In this work, we utilize Symmetry-Breaking Dimensional Expansion (SBDE) as a controlled probe to investigate the mechanism underlying this trade-off. SBDE expands input images by inserting constant-valued pixels, which breaks translational symmetry and consistently improves clean accuracy (e.g., from 90.47% to 95.63% on CIFAR-10 with ResNet-18) by reducing parameter degeneracy. However, this accuracy gain comes at the cost of reduced robustness against iterative white-box attacks. By employing a test-time mask projection that resets the inserted auxiliary pixels to their training values, we demonstrate that the vulnerability stems almost entirely from the inserted dimensions. The projection effectively neutralizes the attacks and restores robustness, revealing that the model achieves high accuracy by creating sharp boundaries (steep loss gradients) specifically along the auxiliary axes. Our findings provide a concrete geometric explanation for the accuracy-robustness paradox: the optimization landscape deepens the basin of attraction to improve accuracy but inevitably erects steep walls along the auxiliary degrees of freedom, creating a fragile sensitivity to off-manifold perturbations.

AI.tldr: 本文利用对称性破缺维度扩展（SBDE）技术揭示了准确率与鲁棒性之间权衡的几何根源：通过插入辅助像素提高准确率，但沿这些辅助维度形成陡峭损失梯度，导致对扰动的脆弱敏感性。
AI.research_question: 深度学习模型中干净准确率与对抗鲁棒性之间权衡的几何机制是什么？
AI.motivation: 准确率与鲁棒性之间的权衡是深度学习中的普遍现象，但其几何起源尚不清晰，本文旨在揭示这一根本机制。
AI.theoretical_framework: 对称性破缺维度扩展（SBDE）、参数简并性、损失景观几何（吸引盆与陡峭边界）
AI.method: 在图像中插入常数值像素（SBDE）打破平移对称性；通过测试时掩码投影重置辅助像素以验证其作用；对比干净准确率与白盒迭代攻击下的鲁棒性变化。
AI.findings: SBDE通过减少参数简并性显著提升干净准确率（如CIFAR-10上ResNet-18从90.47%提升至95.63%），但降低了对抗鲁棒性；脆弱性几乎完全来自插入的辅助维度；测试时掩码投影可有效恢复鲁棒性。
AI.theory_contributions: 为准确率-鲁棒性悖论提供了具体的几何解释：优化加深了吸引盆以提高准确率，但沿辅助自由度建立了陡峭的"墙壁"，导致对离流形扰动的脆弱敏感性。
AI.practical_contributions: 揭示了辅助维度是鲁棒性脆弱的关键来源，为设计兼顾准确率与鲁棒性的模型提供了新的视角和潜在缓解策略。

title: VERITA-QA: Variational Equilibrium and Reliability-Aware IntelligentSystems for Trustworthy Question Answering
affiliations: Alfaisal University, University of Hail,  and National College Of Business Administration & Economics

detail.title: VERITA-QA: Variational Equilibrium and Reliability-Aware IntelligentSystems for Trustworthy Question Answering
detail.abstract: Expert and intelligent systems increasingly support decision-making in knowledge-intensive domains where predictive     accuracy alone is insufficient. Reliable deployment also requires calibrated confidence estimation, uncertaintyaware     adaptation, explainable reasoning, and stable behavior under changing operational conditions. This paper proposes     VERITA-QA, a Variational Equilibrium and Reliability-Aware Intelligent Systems framework for trustworthy     question answering and adaptive decision support. The proposed framework models retrieval-augmented intelligence     as a variational equilibrium process in which predictive utility, uncertainty, calibration reliability, evidence stability,     selective-action behavior, interpretability, and computational complexity are jointly regulated. Rather than relying on     a purely monolithic prediction pipeline, VERITA-QA introduces a staged methodology integrating retrieval-enhanced     representation construction, baseline question-answering models, reliability-aware calibration, uncertainty regulation,     equilibrium-force analysis, selective prediction, explainability, and quantum-inspired optimization. Experimental evaluation     on a public scientific question-answering benchmark demonstrates that the proposed framework provides not     only predictive performance, but also interpretable reliability indicators, calibration-aware confidence behavior, and     equilibrium-guided decision-support evidence. By positioning intelligent question answering as an equilibrium-seeking     process, VERITA-QA provides a reproducible and extensible framework for trustworthy expert and intelligent systems     in information retrieval, scientific reasoning, healthcare intelligence, cybersecurity, energy systems, and other decisionsupport     contexts.

AI.tldr: 本文提出VERITA-QA框架，将检索增强的智能问答建模为变分均衡过程，联合优化预测效用、不确定性、校准可靠性、证据稳定性、选择性行为、可解释性和计算复杂度，在科学问答基准上实现了可信赖的决策支持。
AI.research_question: 如何在知识密集型决策场景中构建兼具预测准确性、校准置信度、不确定性感知、可解释性和稳定性的可信赖智能问答系统？
AI.motivation: 传统预测模型仅关注准确性，但在专家和智能系统中，可靠部署还需要校准的置信度估计、不确定性感知适应、可解释推理以及在变化条件下的稳定行为，因此需要一个统一的框架来联合优化这些维度。
AI.theoretical_framework: 变分均衡过程（Variational Equilibrium Process）；可靠性感知校准（Reliability-Aware Calibration）；不确定性调节（Uncertainty Regulation）；均衡力分析（Equilibrium-Force Analysis）；量子启发优化（Quantum-Inspired Optimization）。
AI.method: 分阶段方法论：检索增强表示构建 → 基线问答模型 → 可靠性感知校准 → 不确定性调节 → 均衡力分析 → 选择性预测 → 可解释性 → 量子启发优化。在公开科学问答基准数据集上进行实验评估。
AI.findings: VERITA-QA不仅提供了预测性能，还提供了可解释的可靠性指标、校准感知的置信度行为以及均衡引导的决策支持证据。
AI.theory_contributions: 将智能问答定位为均衡寻求过程（equilibrium-seeking process），提出变分均衡框架联合优化多个可信赖维度，为可信赖专家和智能系统提供了可复现、可扩展的理论框架。
AI.practical_contributions: VERITA-QA可应用于信息检索、科学推理、医疗智能、网络安全、能源系统等需要可信赖决策支持的领域，提供了可复现和可扩展的实施方案。

title: CARBONIZED PROFIT: DOES THE WORLD WALK THE GREEN TALK?
affiliations: affiliation not provided to SSRN, University of South Alabama, affiliation not provided to SSRN and University of South Alabama

detail.title: CARBONIZED PROFIT: DOES THE WORLD WALK THE GREEN TALK?
detail.abstract: ABSTRACT This research explores the long-term relationship between greenhouse gas (GHG) emissions and operating profit from 2015 to 2025. We introduce the concept of carbonized profitability — the condition in which financial performance, measured by earnings before interest and tax (EBIT), is positively associated with pollution-intensive operations and sourcing. To the best of our knowledge, this paper is one of the most geographically and sectorally diverse studies on the emissions–profitability link to date. Using 30 global panels of 4,614 public firms, we apply fixed-effects and spline panel regressions and apply Gaussian Copula corrections where applicable. All variables are adjusted using employee-count residualization to remove firm-size-correlated effects. Our analysis identifies positive or absent associations in 27 samples (90%). Only three panel regressions (10%) exhibit a negative relationship, including global automotive enterprises and Japanese Nikkei-traded firms. A decade after the Paris Agreement, emissions remain an evident co-product of operations and energy sourcing.

AI.tldr: 本文基于2015-2025年4,614家上市公司的全球面板数据，发现90%的样本中温室气体排放与营业利润呈正相关或无显著关联，仅10%的样本（如全球汽车企业、日经指数公司）呈现负相关，表明碳排放仍是运营与能源采购的副产品。
AI.research_question: 温室气体排放与营业利润之间存在怎样的长期关系？
AI.motivation: 《巴黎协定》签署已逾十年，但企业碳排放与财务绩效之间的关系仍不明确，需要大样本、跨地域、跨行业的实证分析来检验"碳化盈利"（carbonized profitability）这一现象。
AI.theoretical_framework: 碳化盈利（Carbonized Profitability）：财务绩效（EBIT）与污染密集型运营及采购正相关的状态。
AI.method: 采用30个全球面板、4,614家上市公司数据，运用固定效应模型和样条面板回归，在适用情况下采用高斯Copula修正，所有变量均经过员工数残差化处理以去除企业规模相关效应。
AI.findings: 90%的样本（27个）中排放与利润呈正相关或无关联；仅10%的样本（3个）呈负相关，包括全球汽车企业和日本日经指数上市公司。
AI.theory_contributions: 首次在大规模、跨地域、跨行业层面系统验证了"碳化盈利"概念，揭示了排放-利润正关联的普遍性。
AI.practical_contributions: 提示政策制定者和投资者：仅依靠市场力量难以自动实现减排，需更强有力的监管干预来打破"碳化盈利"模式。

title: Hybrid Two-Stage Stochastic Conditional Value at Risk Optimization for Secure Electric Vehicle Battery Supply Chain Design and Operation
affiliations: Lawrence Livermore National Laboratory, Lawrence Livermore National Laboratory, Clemson University, Lawrence Livermore National Laboratory, Lawrence Livermore National Laboratory and Lawrence Livermore National Laboratory

detail.title: Hybrid Two-Stage Stochastic Conditional Value at Risk Optimization for Secure Electric Vehicle Battery Supply Chain Design and Operation
detail.abstract: Batteries serve as the backbone of modern energy storage, driving advancements in both transportation and grid infrastructure. In recent years, we have seen a dramatic increase in demand for battery production, particularly for electric vehicles (EVs). To meet this rapidly growing demand, it is critical for the EV battery supply chain to be designed and operated in a cost-effective yet secure manner. The EV battery supply chain is global and complex, and is subject to mineral price volatility. To address these challenges, we present a hybrid two-stage stochastic Conditional Value at Risk (CVaR) optimization framework. Our model includes international trade relations to reflect the global nature of the supply chain and provides the optimal network design and operation plan in the first and second stage, respectively. Moreover, this approach mitigates risk caused by volatile mineral prices by employing CVaR to reduce the cost from worst-case scenarios. To demonstrate the methodology's advantages, we present case studies based on United States Geological Survey mineral commodity price data to show how our methodology performs in relation to other optimization methods. Our case studies highlight how our approach obtains a supply chain design and operation strategy that reduces risk from high-cost scenarios, while simultaneously reducing average cost across all scenarios.

AI.tldr: 本文提出一种混合两阶段随机条件风险价值（CVaR）优化框架，用于全球电动汽车电池供应链的网络设计与运营规划，以应对矿物价格波动风险，实现成本效益与安全性之间的平衡。
AI.research_question: 如何在矿物价格波动的环境下，设计并运营一个成本效益高且安全的全球电动汽车电池供应链？
AI.motivation: 电动汽车需求快速增长对电池供应链提出了巨大挑战，而该供应链具有全球性、复杂性且受矿物价格波动影响，亟需一种能够兼顾成本最优与风险规避的供应链优化方法。
AI.theoretical_framework: 两阶段随机规划理论；条件风险价值（CVaR）风险度量方法；供应链网络设计理论。
AI.method: 构建混合两阶段随机CVaR优化模型：第一阶段决策供应链网络设计，第二阶段决策运营计划；模型纳入国际贸易关系；使用美国地质调查局矿物商品价格数据进行案例验证。
AI.findings: 所提出的方法能够在降低高成本情景风险的同时，降低所有情景下的平均成本，相比其他优化方法表现更优。
AI.theory_contributions: 将CVaR风险度量与两阶段随机规划相结合，应用于全球电池供应链领域，拓展了供应链风险管理理论在新能源领域的应用边界。
AI.practical_contributions: 为电动汽车电池供应链管理者提供了同时优化网络设计与运营决策的实用工具，帮助企业在矿物价格波动中实现成本控制与风险规避的双重目标。

title: Reduced relative biomass and contrasting exploitation status of blue runner (Caranx crysos) and crevalle jack (Caranx hippos) in artisanal gillnet fisheries of the Colombian Caribbean
affiliations: Universidad del Magdalena and affiliation not provided to SSRN

detail.title: Reduced relative biomass and contrasting exploitation status of blue runner (Caranx crysos) and crevalle jack (Caranx hippos) in artisanal gillnet fisheries of the Colombian Caribbean
detail.abstract: Blue runner (Caranx crysos) and crevalle jack (Caranx hippos) are important components of artisanal fisheries in the Colombian Caribbean, yet information on their population status remains limited. This study estimated growth, mortality, selectivity, and exploitation parameters for both species using length-frequency data collected by the Colombian Fisheries Statistical Service (SEPEC) between 2021 and 2023. Growth parameters were estimated with ELEFAN, whereas mortality and exploitation rates were derived from length-converted catch curves and empirical estimators of natural mortality. Stock status was assessed through Beverton and Holt relative yield-per-recruit (Y′/R) and biomass-per-recruit (B′/R) analyses implemented in TropFishR. Estimated exploitation rates were 0.54 for C. crysos and 0.62 for C. hippos. Yield-per-recruit analyses revealed contrasting exploitation patterns between species. Although the current exploitation level of C. crysos remained below conventional biological reference points, relative biomass per recruit declined to less than 26% of the unfished level. In contrast, C. hippos exceeded both E0.1 and Emax, while B′/R decreased to approximately 20% of the unfished biomass. These results indicate substantial reductions in biomass per recruit for both species, with a more critical condition for C. hippos. The findings highlight the need for precautionary management measures to reduce the capture of immature individuals and safeguard the reproductive capacity of these exploited populations.

AI.tldr: 该研究利用2021-2023年体长频率数据，评估了哥伦比亚加勒比海蓝鲹和卡兰克氏鲹的生长、死亡、选择性和开发参数，发现两种鱼类单位补充量生物量均大幅下降，其中卡兰克氏鲹已超过生物学参考点，处于更危急状态，亟需采取预防性管理措施。
AI.research_question: 哥伦比亚加勒比海蓝鲹（Caranx crysos）和卡兰克氏鲹（Caranx hippos）两种鱼类的种群状况如何？
AI.motivation: 蓝鲹和卡兰克氏鲹是哥伦比亚加勒比海手工渔业的重要组成部分，但关于其种群状况的信息十分有限。缺乏种群评估数据可能导致过度捕捞，威胁渔业可持续性，因此亟需开展种群参数估计与资源状态评估。
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于生长参数估计（ELEFAN）、死亡率和开发率估计（长度转换渔获量曲线及自然死亡率经验估计）以及Beverton-Holt相对单位补充量渔获量（Y′/R）和单位补充量生物量（B′/R）分析。
AI.method: 利用哥伦比亚渔业统计局（SEPEC）2021-2023年体长频率数据，采用ELEFAN估计生长参数，通过长度转换渔获量曲线和自然死亡率经验估计计算死亡率和开发率，使用TropFishR进行Beverton-Holt相对单位补充量分析评估种群状态。
AI.findings: 蓝鲹开发率（0.54）低于生物学参考点，但单位补充量相对生物量降至未开发水平的26%以下；卡兰克氏鲹开发率（0.62）超过E0.1和Emax参考点，单位补充量生物量降至约20%。两种鱼类单位补充量生物量均大幅下降，卡兰克氏鲹状况更危急。
AI.theory_contributions: 为数据有限的鱼类种群评估提供了基于体长频率方法的实证案例，验证了ELEFAN与Beverton-Holt模型在热带手工渔业中的应用效果。
AI.practical_contributions: 为哥伦比亚加勒比海蓝鲹和卡兰克氏鲹的资源管理提供了关键科学依据，建议采取预防性管理措施减少未成熟个体捕捞，保护种群繁殖能力。

title: Regulatory Arbitrage and Market Competition in Municipal Bond Underwriting
affiliations: University of Rhode Island - College of Business and University of Oregon - Charles H. Lundquist School of Business

detail.title: Regulatory Arbitrage and Market Competition in Municipal Bond Underwriting
detail.abstract: This paper studies how municipal bond underwriters exploit threshold exemptions in MSRB Rule G-37 to maintain political connections. We find that underwriters circumvent the two-year business prohibition by clustering donations below the $250 de minimis limit. These multi-small donations target states where underwriters have weak existing market positions. Underwriters also make large donations above the threshold, especially those with geographically concentrated business. We provide evidence that multi-small donations are associated with immediate market share gains, while large donations yield market share gains after a two-year delay—consistent with Rule G-37’s business prohibition. Large donations are further associated with higher underwriting fees and greater bond underpricing, imposing welfare costs on municipal issuers. Our findings suggest that threshold-based contribution limits transform, rather than eliminate, political influence in financial markets.

title: How Micro-Entrepreneurs Make Decisions When Resources Are Tight in Uncertain Markets: Lessons from Brazil
affiliations: affiliation not provided to SSRN and affiliation not provided to SSRN

detail.title: How Micro-Entrepreneurs Make Decisions When Resources Are Tight in Uncertain Markets: Lessons from Brazil
detail.abstract: Micro-entrepreneurs operating with tight resources in uncertain markets must make consequential decisions without the benefit of reliable forecasts. This manuscript translates evidence from verbalized decision protocols with 37 experienced Brazilian micro-entrepreneurs (five or more years in business) into practical decision rules for action. The analysis of coded decision statements shows that entrepreneurs rely more on effectual logic than on predictive planning, yet planning remains present in a lightweight form. The most common moves involve building partnerships, starting from available means, and focusing on what can be controlled immediately. Planning appears mainly as low-cost information seeking and basic market scanning, while competitor analysis is rarely used. These patterns suggest that, under persistent uncertainty and scarcity, entrepreneurs combine limited planning with stakeholder commitments and rapid execution to sustain viability and adapt. The manuscript converts these insights into an applied playbook for entrepreneurs and for organizations that support them, including a quick choice guide for when to plan versus when to co-create with partners, checklists to expand resources through commitments, a 30–60–90 day rollout plan, and simple metrics to track progress.

AI.tldr: 本研究通过对37位经验丰富的巴西微型企业家的决策口述进行编码分析，发现他们在资源稀缺和高度不确定的市场中更依赖效果逻辑（而非预测性规划），并将这些发现转化为一套包含快速选择指南、资源扩展清单、30-60-90天推进计划和简单进度指标的实用决策手册。
AI.research_question: 在资源紧张和不确定市场中，微型企业家如何做出关键决策？他们使用什么样的决策逻辑？
AI.motivation: 微型企业家在缺乏可靠预测的情况下必须做出重大决策，但现有研究对他们在极端不确定性和资源匮乏条件下的实际决策过程了解不足，且缺乏将研究发现转化为可操作工具的研究。
AI.theoretical_framework: 效果逻辑理论（Effectuation theory）与预测规划逻辑（Predictive planning）的对比框架。
AI.method: 对37位拥有五年以上经营经验的巴西微型企业家进行口述决策协议（verbalized decision protocols）收集，对决策陈述进行编码分析。
AI.findings: 企业家更依赖效果逻辑而非预测性规划，但规划以轻量形式存在；最常见的决策动作包括建立合伙关系、从已有资源出发、关注可立即控制的事情；规划主要表现为低成本信息搜索和基本市场扫描，极少进行竞争对手分析。
AI.theory_contributions: 在极端不确定性和资源匮乏的微观情境下，验证并细化了效果逻辑的运作机制，揭示了"轻量规划"与效果逻辑共存的决策模式，丰富了创业决策理论在BOP（金字塔底层）市场的适用性。
AI.practical_contributions: 提供了可直接应用的微型企业家决策手册，包括：何时规划与何时与合作伙伴共创的快速选择指南、通过承诺扩展资源的清单、30-60-90天推进计划、以及简单进度跟踪指标。

title: Government Accounting Oversight and Corporate Violations: Evidence from China’s Random Inspections of Accounting Information Quality
affiliations: North China University of Technology, North China University of Technology, North China University of Technology, North China University of Technology and Zhongshan University

detail.title: Government Accounting Oversight and Corporate Violations: Evidence from China’s Random Inspections of Accounting Information Quality
detail.abstract: Fiscal and accounting supervision is a critical pillar of China’s Party- and state-led oversight architecture. Its role in governing and curbing firm-level corporate violations has attracted growing attention from both scholars and practitioners. Using a sample of Chinese A-share listed firms from 2007 to 2024, this study leverages the Ministry of Finance’s random inspection program for accounting information quality as a quasi-natural experiment. Employing a staggered difference-in-differences design, we examine the effect of government accounting oversight on corporate violations and explore the underlying transmission channels. The results show that government accounting oversight significantly reduces both the likelihood and frequency of corporate violations. These findings remain robust across a series of checks, including the parallel trends test, propensity score matching DID, placebo test, and controls for concurrent policy shocks. Mechanism analyses indicate that the disciplinary effect operates through three primary channels: (1) reducing internal control weaknesses and thereby lowering operational risk; (2) restraining managerial short-termism and improving corporate governance; and (3) enhancing audit supervision quality and strengthening the information environment. Heterogeneity analyses further suggest that the governance effect is more pronounced among firms with lower business complexity, firms located in regions with weaker legal environments, and firms operating in more competitive industries. Additional analyses show that government accounting oversight not only directly curbs corporate violations but also generates positive spillovers, notably by reducing the risk of stock price crashes and improving the quality of information disclosure. This study advances the literature on external public governance and corporate violations by providing systematic evidence on the channels through which government accounting oversight constrains violations. The findings offer empirical support for refining China’s modern fiscal and accounting supervision system and for implementing more targeted regulatory policies. They also provide practical implications for listed firms seeking to strengthen internal compliance and mitigate capital market risk.

AI.tldr: 利用财政部会计信息质量随机检查作为准自然实验，采用交错DID方法，发现政府会计监督显著降低了企业违规的可能性和频率，作用机制包括减少内控缺陷、抑制管理层短视、提升审计质量，并产生正向溢出效应。
AI.research_question: 政府会计监督如何影响企业违规行为？其传导机制是什么？
AI.motivation: 财政会计监督是党和国家监督体系的重要支柱，但其对微观企业违规行为的治理效果及作用路径尚缺乏系统的实证证据。
AI.theoretical_framework: 外部公共治理理论；政府会计监督通过降低内控风险、抑制管理层短视、强化审计监督三条渠道约束企业违规。
AI.method: 以2007-2024年中国A股上市公司为样本，以财政部会计信息质量随机检查为准自然实验，采用交错双重差分（staggered DID）模型，辅以平行趋势检验、PSM-DID、安慰剂检验、控制同期政策冲击等稳健性检验。
AI.findings: 政府会计监督显著降低企业违规的可能性和频率；机制为减少内控缺陷、抑制管理层短视、提升审计监督质量；在业务复杂度低、法律环境弱、竞争激烈行业中的企业效果更明显；同时降低股价崩盘风险、提升信息披露质量，产生积极溢出效应。
AI.theory_contributions: 为外部公共治理与企业违规的文献提供了政府会计监督约束违规的系统性渠道证据，丰富了准自然实验视角下的政府监管研究。
AI.practical_contributions: 为完善中国现代财政会计监督体系和制定更精准的监管政策提供实证支持，也为上市公司加强内部合规、防范资本市场风险提供实践启示。

title: Leading Innovation with Agentic AI: A Systematic Review of Human–AI Collaboration in the Industry 5.0 Era
affiliations: University of Bamberg and University of Bamberg

detail.title: Leading Innovation with Agentic AI: A Systematic Review of Human–AI Collaboration in the Industry 5.0 Era
detail.abstract: The rapid emergence of Agentic AI systems capable of autonomous decision-making, contextual learning, and adaptive behaviour –is reshaping innovation leadership. This research examines Agentic AI role in corporate innovation leadership during the Industry 5.0 paradigm shift.Drawing on 50 peer-reviewed studies(2015-2025) and integrating Transformational Leadership Theory, Technology Acceptance Model, and Sociotechnical Systems Theory, we find that human-AI collaboration fosters innovation agility, ethical innovation, and strategic innovation. While Agentic AI enhances evidence-based leadership and adaptability, transparency, trust and role ambiguity require ethical governance. Agentic AI is positioned not as a replacement for human leaders, but as a strategic cognitive partner.

AI.tldr: 本文探讨了Agentic AI（自主智能体AI）在工业5.0背景下对企业创新领导力的影响，基于50篇同行评审研究（2015-2025），整合变革型领导理论、技术接受模型和社会技术系统理论，发现人机协作能促进创新敏捷性、伦理创新和战略创新，并指出Agentic AI应作为人类领导者的战略认知伙伴而非替代者。
AI.research_question: Agentic AI在工业5.0范式转变中如何影响企业创新领导力？
AI.motivation: Agentic AI系统（具备自主决策、情境学习和自适应行为的能力）正在迅速崛起，重塑创新领导力格局，但对其在企业创新领导力中的具体作用机制、利弊以及治理需求缺乏系统性研究。

title: PRISM: Cost-Governed Adaptive Reasoning for Autonomous Recovery in Cloud-Native Lakehouse Pipelines
affiliations: affiliation not provided to SSRN

detail.title: PRISM: Cost-Governed Adaptive Reasoning for Autonomous Recovery in Cloud-Native Lakehouse Pipelines
detail.abstract: Cloud-native lakehouse pipelines fail in ways that retry-based orchestrators cannot resolve: a schema change is blindly re-executed rather than reconciled, an upstream latency spike is retried rather than recognized as a downstream service-level agreement (SLA) breach in waiting, and compound failures that span the schema, workload, and SLA layers simultaneously exceed any statically encoded remediation rule. Semantic reasoning with large language models (LLMs) can close this gap, but invoking an LLM on every operational event is prohibitively expensive and slow for production pipelines. This paper presents PRISM, whose central mechanism is the Adaptive Reasoning Governor (ARG): a lightweight, complexity-aware policy that decides, per event, whether a failure warrants the cost and latency of semantic reasoning or can be resolved by a deterministic fast path. The ARG routes only 7.3% of operational events to LLM reasoning, reducing inference cost by 87.7% relative to a full-LLM configuration while preserving 94.1% of its decision quality. Around this governor, PRISM coordinates schema management, workload balancing, SLA enforcement, and lineage-aware root cause analysis through a shared metadata fabric and a rollback-safe execution model.We evaluate PRISM using controlled fault-injection experiments over a synthetic financial transaction pipeline containing 50 million records and 47 orchestration DAGs. Across five independent evaluation runs, PRISM reduces mean time to resolution (MTTR) from 21.7 ± 3.4 minutes in a rule-based self-healing baseline to 9.6 ± 1.4 minutes while improving schema drift detection precision to 90.9% and SLA compliance to 96.0%.

AI.tldr: PRISM 是一个面向云原生湖仓管道的智能故障管理系统，通过自适应推理调控器（ARG）在确定性快速路径与LLM语义推理之间动态选择，仅用7.3%的事件触发LLM即可保留94.1%的决策质量，将平均修复时间从21.7分钟降至9.6分钟。
AI.research_question: 如何在不引入过高成本和延迟的前提下，利用大语言模型的语义推理能力来修复云原生湖仓管道中重试机制无法解决的复杂故障？
AI.motivation: 现有基于重试的编排器无法处理模式变更、上游延迟峰值、以及跨模式/负载/SLA层的复合故障，而全面引入LLM推理又成本过高、速度过慢。
AI.theoretical_framework: 自适应推理调控（Adaptive Reasoning Governor, ARG）；复杂度感知策略；确定性快速路径 vs. LLM语义推理路径的混合决策。
AI.method: 设计PRISM系统，包含ARG核心调控器、共享元数据织物、回滚安全执行模型；在合成金融交易管道（5000万条记录、47个编排DAG）上进行控制故障注入实验。
AI.findings: ARG仅将7.3%的事件路由至LLM推理，推理成本降低87.7%，决策质量保留94.1%；MTTR从21.7分钟降至9.6分钟；模式漂移检测精确率达90.9%；SLA合规率达96.0%。
AI.theory_contributions: 提出面向云原生管道的自适应推理调控机制，在语义推理精度与系统开销之间建立可量化的权衡框架。
AI.practical_contributions: 为生产环境中的湖仓管道提供了一种低成本、高可靠的智能故障管理与自动修复方案，显著降低运维成本与故障恢复时间。

title: Risk leadership in R&D projects: A decentralized, learning‐oriented governance framework

detail.title: Risk leadership in R&D projects: A decentralized, learning‐oriented governance framework
detail.abstract: Innovation‐intensive R&D projects face high uncertainty, interdependence and rapid change, exposing limits of traditional risk management. This paper introduces the Decentralized Risk Leadership Framework (DRLF), integrating distributed leadership, participatory decision‐making and organizational learning into Enterprise Risk Management. The framework is developed through a systematic review of 46 studies (2020–2025) and an illustrative R&D project. Results indicate decentralized leadership enhances risk sensing, accelerates response times, and strengthens stakeholder engagement, improving project resilience and strategic alignment. DRLF provides managers a practical tool to improve transparency, responsiveness and learning in innovation ecosystems, linking leadership, governance and learning into a model for uncertain environments.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了去中心化风险领导力框架（DRLF），通过整合分布式领导、参与式决策和组织学习来改进企业风险管理，适用于高不确定性的创新密集型研发项目。基于46篇文献（2020-2025）的系统综述和一个示例性研发项目，研究表明去中心化领导能增强风险感知、加快响应速度并加强利益相关者参与，从而提升项目韧性和战略一致性。
AI.research_question: 在高不确定性、相互依赖和快速变化的创新密集型研发项目中，传统风险管理存在局限，如何通过去中心化风险领导力框架（DRLF）来改进企业风险管理？
AI.motivation: 创新密集型研发项目面临高度不确定性、相互依赖性和快速变化，传统的风险管理方法已暴露出局限性，亟需新的理论框架来应对这些挑战。
AI.theoretical_framework: 分布式领导理论、参与式决策理论、组织学习理论，以及企业风险管理（ERM）理论的整合。
AI.method: 对46篇2020-2025年间的文献进行系统综述，并结合一个示例性研发项目进行说明。
AI.findings: 去中心化领导能增强风险感知、加速响应时间、加强利益相关者参与，从而提升项目韧性和战略一致性。

AI.practical_contributions: 为管理者提供了一个实用的工具（DRLF），用于在创新生态系统中提高透明度、响应能力和学习能力，帮助研发项目更好地应对不确定性。

title: THE MISALIGNMENT TAX:Bridging Human Resources and Business Strategyfor Sustainable Organizational Performance
affiliations: affiliation not provided to SSRN

detail.title: THE MISALIGNMENT TAX:Bridging Human Resources and Business Strategyfor Sustainable Organizational Performance
detail.abstract: Despite decades of research affirming the strategic value of human resources, most organizations continue to treat HR as a downstream support function rather than a primary driver of competitive advantage. This paper argues that the structural, linguistic, and cultural disconnection between HR and business strategy constitutes a measurable financial liability: what we term the "misalignment tax." Drawing on data from Gallup, Workday, Gartner, SHRM, the U.S. Bureau of Labor Statistics, Ocean Tomo, Deloitte, and multiple 2025-2026 industry surveys, and grounded in more than 35 years of direct practitioner observation across organizational transformations, we document the quantitative costs of misalignment and evaluate a portfolio of creative, evidence-based solutions. We examine four dimensions that most alignment literature overlooks: the generational workforce tipping point arriving by 2030; the broken accounting framework that structurally penalizes people investment; the psychological contract as the emotional mechanism behind disengagement; and the emerging investor and regulatory pressure around human capital disclosure. We give particular attention to the HR Business Partner model as the primary structural vehicle for translating alignment philosophy into operational reality, including the specific competencies that distinguish an effective HRBP from traditional HR operations. We conclude with a practical framework of financial metrics that translate people outcomes into the language of capital allocation, enabling HR leaders to make their case in terms that boards and CFOs cannot dismiss.

AI.tldr: 本文提出"错位税"概念，量化HR与业务战略脱节带来的财务损失，基于多项调查数据和35年从业观察，从代际更替、会计框架缺陷、心理契约、监管压力四个维度分析问题，并以HRBP模型为切入点，提出将人力成果转化为资本配置语言的可操作财务指标框架。
AI.research_question: HR与业务战略的结构性脱节如何构成可量化的财务负债？如何通过创造性解决方案弥合这一错位？
AI.motivation: 尽管数十年研究确认了人力资源的战略价值，但多数组织仍将HR视为后端支持职能而非竞争优势的主要驱动力，这种脱节的成本尚未被系统量化。
AI.theoretical_framework: 错位税（misalignment tax）；心理契约理论；人力资本披露与资本配置语言转换框架。
AI.method: 多源数据整合（Gallup、Workday、Gartner、SHRM、BLS、Ocean Tomo、Deloitte等）结合35年以上从业者直接观察与组织转型实践。
AI.findings: HR与战略脱节存在可测量的财务成本；四个被忽视的维度（2030年代际拐点、会计框架对人力投资的惩罚、心理契约作为脱钩的情感机制、投资者与监管压力）是关键变量；有效HRBP需具备区别于传统HR的特定胜任力。
AI.theory_contributions: 首次系统定义并量化"错位税"概念；将被忽视的四维度纳入HR-战略对齐的分析框架；提出HRBP作为对齐运营机制的理论定位。
AI.practical_contributions: 提供将人力成果转化为资本分配语言的财务指标框架，帮助HR领导者以董事会和CFO无法忽视的方式论证人力投资价值。

detail.title: Title The impact of leadership behaviours on older volunteers’ engagement, satisfaction and retention in local government and not-for-profit organisations: A scoping reviewRunning Head:Leadership and Older VolunteersAuthors:Walker, T1, Burgess, J2, and Ambagtsheer, R.C.1AffiliationsHealth & Education Faculty, Torrens University Australia, Adelaide, South Australia, AustraliaBusiness & Hospitality Faculty, Torrens University Australia, New South Wales, AustraliaCorresponding Author: Tracy Walker: tracy.walker@education.torrens.edu.au
detail.abstract: AbstractIntroduction:Older volunteers play a vital role in sustaining community services and contribute social and economic value. Volunteering is associated with enhanced well-being and reduced social isolation among older adults. Despite these benefits, participation in volunteering has declined, presenting challenges for local government and not-for-profit organisations. Understanding how leadership influences engagement and retention is important.Objective:This scoping review examined research identifying leadership behaviours that support engagement, satisfaction, and retention of older volunteers in local government and not-for-profit contexts.Methods:Guided by the Joanna Briggs Institute methodology and pre-registered with the Open Science Framework, this review included English language studies published between 1 January 1999 and 1 February 2025. Databases searched included ProQuest Central, Scopus, PubMed, JSTOR, Ebsco (all databases), CINAHL, Medline, Ageline, and Google Scholar (100 advanced search results). Search terms focused on leadership, volunteer engagement, and organisational contexts involving older adults (median age 65 years).Results:Of 3,481 records screened, eight studies met inclusion criteria across local government and not-for-profit community service settings. Volunteer withdrawal was linked to poor management practices, while flexibility, recognition, and supportive approaches enhanced satisfaction and retention. Recommended strategies were largely framed as Human Resource Management processes rather than leadership behaviours or theoretical models.Discussion:Findings demonstrate a gap in research addressing leadership practices specific to older volunteers. Organisational context appears to influence effective leadership approaches.Conclusion:This scoping review demonstrates the need for further research to inform leadership practices that align with older volunteers’ values, strengthening engagement, retention, and sustainable community programmes.

AI.tldr: 这篇范围综述探讨了影响老年志愿者参与、满意度和留任的领导力行为，发现现有研究主要将策略框定为人力资源管理流程，而非领导力理论模型，存在明显的研究空白。
AI.research_question: 哪些领导力行为能够支持地方政府和非营利组织中老年志愿者的参与、满意度和留任？
AI.motivation: 老年志愿者对社区服务至关重要，但志愿服务参与率持续下降，而关于领导力如何影响老年志愿者参与和留任的研究不足。
AI.theoretical_framework: 范围综述方法论（Joanna Briggs Institute方法）；领导力理论视角
AI.method: 范围综述，检索1999年1月1日至2025年2月1日的英文文献，涵盖ProQuest Central、Scopus、PubMed等9个数据库，筛选3,481条记录，最终纳入8项研究。
AI.findings: 志愿服务退出与不良管理实践相关；灵活性、认可和支持性方法可提升满意度和留任；推荐策略多被框定为人力资源管理流程而非领导力行为或理论模型。
AI.theory_contributions: 揭示了针对老年志愿者的领导力实践研究存在空白，指出组织情境影响有效领导力方法，呼吁发展基于领导力理论的实践框架。
AI.practical_contributions: 为地方政府和非营利组织提供管理实践建议：采用灵活、认可和支持性的领导方式，以促进老年志愿者的参与和留任，增强社区项目的可持续性。

detail.title: A Review of Deep Learning-based Super-Resolution Methods for Medical Imagery Sequences
detail.abstract: Medical image super-resolution (SR) aims to reconstruct high-resolution (HR) images from low-resolution (LR) inputs and plays a critical role in enhancing diagnostic accuracy and treatment planning. While previous surveys have extensively covered single-image SR techniques, comparatively little attention has been paid to the emerging domain of multi-slice or sequence-based medical image SR, which exploits spatial and temporal correlations across adjacent slices or frames. This paper presents the first comprehensive survey dedicated to super-resolution of medical image sequences. We introduce a novel stereoscopic taxonomy structured as a dual-dimensional classification framework, categorizing existing methods according to two key aspects: (1) input sequence types (static image sequences or dynamic video frames) and (2) imaging spatial dimensions (in-plane, through-plane, and volumetric). This taxonomy offers a unified perspective on SR techniques applied across diverse medical imaging modalities, including magnetic resonance imaging (MRI), computed tomography (CT), ultrasound, and endoscopy. Furthermore, we summarize widely used degradation models, image quality assessment metrics, and benchmark datasets. Finally, we systematically evaluate the strengths and limitations of state-of-the-art methods and highlight emerging trends and open challenges in the field.

AI.tldr: 本文首次全面综述了医学图像序列超分辨率领域，提出了一种新颖的立体分类框架，从输入序列类型和成像空间维度两个维度对现有方法进行分类，并系统总结了退化模型、评估指标、基准数据集及未来挑战。
AI.research_question: 如何系统性地分类和综述医学图像序列超分辨率领域的现有方法、评估体系及未来方向？
AI.motivation: 现有综述主要关注单幅图像超分辨率，而对利用时空相关性的多切片或序列医学图像超分辨率关注不足，该领域缺乏系统性的分类框架和全面综述。
AI.theoretical_framework: 立体分类框架（双维度分类）：(1) 输入序列类型（静态图像序列 vs. 动态视频帧）；(2) 成像空间维度（平面内、跨平面、体积）。
AI.method: 系统性文献综述，提出双维度立体分类法，对现有方法进行归类，并总结退化模型、评估指标和基准数据集。
AI.findings: 提出首个面向医学图像序列超分辨率的综合综述；建立了基于输入类型和空间维度的双维度分类体系；涵盖了MRI、CT、超声和内镜等多种模态；系统评估了现有方法的优缺点并指出了未来研究方向。
AI.theory_contributions: 首次提出医学图像序列超分辨率的立体分类框架（双维分类法），为该领域提供了统一的理论视角和分析范式。
AI.practical_contributions: 系统梳理了主流退化模型、质量评估指标和基准数据集，为研究人员提供了实用的工具参考；通过评估现有方法优劣势，为实际应用中的方法选择提供了指导。

title: Influences of climate change and hydropower development on the surface water storage of Tonle Sap Lake
affiliations: affiliation not provided to SSRN, affiliation not provided to SSRN, affiliation not provided to SSRN and Changjiang River Scientific Research Institute

detail.title: Influences of climate change and hydropower development on the surface water storage of Tonle Sap Lake
detail.abstract: Tonle Sap Lake (TSL), the largest freshwater lake in Southeast Asia, is vital to the hydrology, ecology and food security of the Lancang-Mekong River Basin (LMRB). Owing to climate change and intensive hydropower development in the upper Lancang River, the hydrological regime of TSL has changed, yet few studies have addressed these impacts using long-term data and multiple indicators. This study analyzed long-term climatic and drought indices of LMRB from 1988 to 2023, as well as satellite-derived surface water areas of TSL, to explore the response of TSL to climate change and upstream hydropower development. The results showed that precipitation, potential evapotranspiration (PET) and the 3-month Standardized Precipitation Index (SPI-3) exhibited no significant long-term trends, whereas the 3-month Standardized Precipitation Evapotranspiration Index (SPEI-3) decreased notably, indicating an intensifying drying trend in the basin. The surface water area of TSL presented a significant interannual decline and distinct seasonal fluctuations. After the impoundment of the Xiaowan Hydropower Station in 2009, the shrinkage rate of surface water area of TSL accelerated with a simultaneous sharp drop in SPEI-3. It can be concluded that upstream hydropower development is the dominant driver of the shrinkage, while climate change further exacerbates drought risks in the region. These findings provide scientific support for transboundary water resource management and ecological protection of LMRB.

AI.tldr: 本研究分析了1988-2023年湄公河流域气候与干旱指标及洞里萨湖水面面积，发现上游水电开发是湖泊萎缩的主导因素，气候变化则加剧了区域干旱风险。
AI.research_question: 洞里萨湖的水文情势如何响应气候变化与上游水电开发？
AI.motivation: 洞里萨湖是东南亚最大淡水湖，对流域水文、生态和粮食安全至关重要，但以往缺乏基于长期数据和多指标的气候变化与水电开发影响研究。
AI.theoretical_framework: 气候变化与水电梯级开发对湖泊水文情势的影响理论；标准化降水指数（SPI）与标准化降水蒸散指数（SPEI）的干旱监测框架。
AI.method: 采用1988-2023年长期气候、干旱指数（SPI-3、SPEI-3）数据，以及卫星遥感获取的洞里萨湖水面面积数据，进行趋势分析与关联性检验。
AI.findings: 降水和SPI-3无显著趋势，但SPEI-3显著下降，表明流域变干；湖面面积呈显著年际下降和季节性波动；2009年小湾水电站蓄水后湖面萎缩加速，与SPEI-3骤降同步。
AI.theory_contributions: 首次采用长期多指标数据，区分了水电开发与气候变化对洞里萨湖萎缩的相对贡献，揭示了水电开发是主导驱动因素。
AI.practical_contributions: 为澜沧江-湄公河流域的跨境水资源管理和生态保护提供了科学依据。

title: Multi-omics Classification with Cross-GCN Fusion Network
affiliations: , affiliation not provided to SSRN and affiliation not provided to SSRN

detail.title: Multi-omics Classification with Cross-GCN Fusion Network
detail.abstract: High-throughput sequencing has enabled the large-scale acquisition of multi-omics data across genomic, transcriptomic, and epigenomic layers. Integrating these heterogeneous modalities is important for disease classification, yet remains challenging because of high dimensionality, modality-specific noise, and complex dependencies across omics views. We propose MOCGF, a Multi-omics Classification framework with Cross-GCN Fusion, for patient-level classification using mRNA expression, DNA methylation, and miRNA expression data. For each modality, a patient-similarity graph is constructed and processed by a dedicated Graph Convolutional Network to capture cohort-level structure. A gated cross-modal update mechanism is then introduced to regulate information exchange across modalities and reduce the propagation of irrelevant or noisy signals. To integrate the resulting embeddings, we propose a dual-path fusion module that models both similarity- and difference-based signals, enabling the controlled combination of shared and complementary information. Experiments on three public cohorts, BRCA, KIPAN, and ROSMAP, show that MOCGF achieves competitive performance against recent graph-based methods. The framework achieves the highest Macro-F1 among the compared three-modality methods on BRCA, performs competitively with graph-based models on KIPAN, and remains competitive on ROSMAP in Accuracy and F1 score, although performance varies across metrics. Ablation and modality studies indicate that graph encoding provides the main representational gain, with additional benefits from gated cross-modal exchange and the proposed fusion strategy. These results suggest that controlled cross-graph fusion is a useful approach for multi-omics classification under complete-modality settings.

AI.tldr: 提出MOCGF框架，通过跨图融合网络（Cross-GCN Fusion）整合多组学数据（mRNA表达、DNA甲基化、miRNA表达）进行疾病分类。核心创新包括：逐模态构建患者相似图并利用GCN编码、门控跨模态更新机制降噪、双路径融合模块结合共享与互补信息。在BRCA、KIPAN、ROSMAP三个公共数据集上取得有竞争力的分类性能。
AI.research_question: 如何有效整合基因组、转录组、表观遗传组等多组学异质数据，实现高维、多噪声、跨模态依赖条件下的疾病分类？
AI.motivation: 多组学数据整合对疾病分类至关重要，但面临维度灾难、模态特异性噪声、模态间复杂依赖关系三大挑战。现有图融合方法在信息交换的控制和共享/互补信息的建模上仍有不足。
AI.theoretical_framework: 图卷积网络（GCN）、门控机制、双路径融合（相似性与差异性信号建模）、跨模态信息交换理论。
AI.method: (1) 对每种组学模态构建患者相似图；(2) 各自用GCN提取患者嵌入；(3) 门控跨模态更新机制调节模态间信息交换，抑制噪声传播；(4) 双路径融合模块：分别建模模态间的相似性信号和差异性信号，实现共享与互补信息的受控组合。
AI.findings: (1) MOCGF在BRCA数据集上达到最高Macro-F1；(2) 在KIPAN上与图方法竞争力相当；(3) 在ROSMAP上准确率和F1有竞争力但指标间存在波动；(4) 消融实验表明：图编码为主要性能来源，门控跨模态交换和双路径融合策略进一步带来增益。
AI.theory_contributions: (1) 提出门控跨模态更新机制，实现对跨模态信息流动的受控调节；(2) 提出双路径融合模块，首次在组学整合中同时建模模态间的相似性和差异性信号。
AI.practical_contributions: (1) 提供一种在完整模态设置下有效整合多组学数据的可操作框架；(2) 在三种公共癌症/疾病数据集上验证了方法的实际分类有效性。

title: CLARE: A Causal machine Learning Approach to Resilience Estimation
affiliations: World Bank - Development Data Group (DECDG), Sapienza University of Rome - Department of Social Sciences and Economics, Sapienza University of Rome (Italy) and Sapienza University of Rome

detail.title: CLARE: A Causal machine Learning Approach to Resilience Estimation
detail.abstract: This paper proposes a new resilience index, CLARE (Causal machine Learning Approach to Resilience Estimation), rooted in an impact evaluation framework and causal machine learning methods applied to longitudinal household survey data. The indicator is model-agnostic, scalable, and normatively anchored to wellbeing thresholds, and can be implemented as either a shock-specific index or a general-purpose resilience metric. We provide an empirical demonstration of how to construct CLARE, leveraging over 30,000 observations from 19 nationally representative, longitudinal, multi-topic surveys implemented by the national statistical offices in Malawi, Nigeria, Tanzania, and Uganda over 2009–2020 in partnership with the World Bank Living Standards Measurement Study, together with three distinct sources of external weather data. We illustrate the approach by estimating drought-related resilience, and we also construct a broader resilience measure based on a broader set of covariate shocks. The analysis shows that CLARE outperforms existing resilience metrics and alternative approaches in predicting food insecurity out of sample. Because the index is constructed to reflect the relative importance of resilience components in shaping heterogeneity in shock impacts, it helps identify capacities that insulate households from adverse events and can be operationalized for the design, targeting, and monitoring of policies and investments aimed at strengthening resilience. CLARE’s deployment, paired with continued investment in national longitudinal survey platforms, could strengthen early warning and anticipatory action and support the transfer of resilience measurement and policy insights from data-rich contexts to data-poor environments that may not immediately provide the requisite longitudinal data for index estimation.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种基于因果机器学习和纵向家庭调查数据的新型韧性指数CLARE，通过整合超过3万个观测数据和外部天气数据，构建了模型无关、可扩展的韧性评估指标，在预测粮食不安全方面优于现有方法，并可用于政策设计与监测。
AI.research_question: 如何构建一个基于因果推断框架、可扩展、模型无关且具有规范性福利阈值锚定的韧性指标，以准确评估家庭层面的抗冲击能力？
AI.motivation: 现有韧性指标在因果推断基础、可扩展性和规范性锚定方面存在不足，难以准确识别和量化家庭抵御冲击的能力，亟需一个更具方法论根基和操作可行性的新指标。
AI.theoretical_framework: 因果机器学习框架、冲击影响评估框架、韧性理论、福利阈值锚定方法。
AI.method: 基于因果机器学习方法，利用马拉维、尼日利亚、坦桑尼亚和乌干达四国2009-2020年的19轮全国代表性纵向调查数据（超过3万个观测值），结合三种外部天气数据源，构建CLARE指数，并通过样本外预测能力检验其优越性。
AI.findings: CLARE指数在样本外预测粮食不安全方面优于现有韧性指标和替代方法；该指数能够反映韧性各组成部分在塑造冲击影响异质性中的相对重要性，有助于识别保护家庭免受不利事件影响的能力因素。
AI.theory_contributions: 将因果机器学习引入韧性测量领域，提出了一个具有因果推断基础、模型无关且规范锚定的新韧性指标框架，为韧性理论的操作化提供了方法论创新。
AI.practical_contributions: CLARE可用于韧性政策的设计、目标定位和效果监测；配合国家纵向调查平台的持续投入，可加强早期预警和前瞻性行动，并将韧性测量和政策洞见从数据丰富环境迁移到数据匮乏环境。

title: INCRT: An Incremental Transformer That Determines Its Own Architecture
affiliations: affiliation not provided to SSRN

detail.title: INCRT: An Incremental Transformer That Determines Its Own Architecture
detail.abstract: Transformer architectures are designed by trial and error: the number of attention heads, the depth, and the head size are fixed before training begins, with no mathematical principle to guide the choice. The result is systematic structural redundancy — between half and four-fifths of all heads in a trained model can be removed without measurable loss — because the architecture allocates capacity without reference to the actual requirements of the task.This paper introduces INCRT (Incremental Transformer), an architecture that determines its own structure during training. Starting from a single head, INCRT adds one attention head at a time whenever its current configuration is provably insufficient, and prunes heads that have become redundant. Each growth decision is driven by a single, online-computable geometric quantity derived from the task's directional structure, requiring no separate validation phase and no hand-tuned schedule.Two theorems form the theoretical backbone. The first (homeostatic convergence) establishes that the system always reaches a finite stopping configuration that is simultaneously minimal (no redundant heads) and sufficient (no uncaptured directional energy above the threshold). The second (compressed-sensing analogy) provides a geometric upper bound on the number of heads that this configuration can contain, as a function of the spectral complexity of the task.Experiments on SARS-CoV-2 variant classification and SST-2 sentiment analysis confirm both results: the predicted and observed head counts agree within 12% across all benchmarks, and the final architectures match or exceed BERT-base on distribution-specific tasks while using between three and seven times fewer parameters and no pre-training.

AI.tldr: 本文提出INCRT（增量式Transformer），一种在训练过程中自主决定自身结构的架构。它从单头开始，每当当前配置被证明不足时逐个添加注意力头，并剪枝冗余头。每次增长决策由任务方向结构导出的单个可在线计算的几何量驱动，无需单独的验证阶段或手动调参。两个定理构成理论基础：稳态收敛定理保证系统达到同时最小且充分的有限停止配置；压缩感知类比定理提供该配置中头数量的几何上界。在SARS-CoV-2变体分类和SST-2情感分析实验中，预测与观测的头数在12%内吻合，最终架构在分布特定任务上匹配或超越BERT-base，同时使用3到7倍更少的参数且无需预训练。
AI.research_question: 如何设计一种能够在训练过程中自主决定注意力头数量、深度和头大小的Transformer架构，消除结构冗余，同时保证性能不低于人工设计的架构？
AI.motivation: 传统Transformer架构通过试错法设计，在训练前固定注意力头数、深度和头大小，缺乏数学原则指导，导致系统性的结构冗余——训练模型中50%到80%的头可以被移除而不造成可测量的性能损失。这种冗余源于架构在不考虑任务实际需求的情况下分配容量。
AI.theoretical_framework: 两个关键定理：（1）稳态收敛定理（Homeostatic Convergence）——系统始终达到一个有限停止配置，该配置同时是极小的（无冗余头）和充分的（无超过阈值的未捕获方向能量）；（2）压缩感知类比定理（Compressed-Sensing Analogy）——提供停止配置中头数量的几何上界，该上界是任务谱复杂度的函数。
AI.method: INCRT架构：从单头开始训练，基于任务方向结构导出的单个可在线计算的几何量判断何时添加头，并在必要时剪枝冗余头。增长决策无需单独的验证阶段或手动调参。
AI.findings: （1）预测与观测的头数在所有基准测试中吻合度在12%以内；（2）最终架构在分布特定任务上匹配或超越BERT-base；（3）使用3到7倍更少的参数；（4）无需预训练。
AI.theory_contributions: （1）首次从理论上证明了注意力头数量的自确定机制可以同时达到最小性和充分性；（2）建立了注意力头数量与任务谱复杂度之间的几何上界关系，将架构设计与任务需求建立数学联系。
AI.practical_contributions: （1）大幅减少Transformer架构的设计试错成本；（2）显著降低模型参数量（3-7倍）而不牺牲性能；（3）消除预训练需求，可在小样本场景下直接应用；（4）为端到端的自动架构演化提供了可解释的数学基础。

title: Emergence, State Transitions, and Nonlinear Evolution of Urban Traffic Congestion: Insights from Explainable Artificial Intelligence
affiliations: Huaiyin Institute of Technology, Huaiyin Institute of Technology, Huaiyin Institute of Technology, Huaiyin Institute of Technology, Huaiyin Institute of Technology and Kunming University of Science and Technology

detail.title: Emergence, State Transitions, and Nonlinear Evolution of Urban Traffic Congestion: Insights from Explainable Artificial Intelligence
detail.abstract: Urban traffic congestion is an emergent phenomenon arising from complex interactions among traffic demand, infrastructure constraints, land-use patterns, and human mobility behaviors. Despite extensive research on congestion prediction, the nonlinear evolution mechanisms governing congestion formation and state transitions remain insufficiently understood. This limitation hinders the development of a unified understanding of congestion dynamics from a complex-system perspective.To address this gap, this study proposes an explainable machine-learning framework to uncover the nonlinear evolution mechanism of urban traffic congestion. Using multi-source urban data collected from Guiyang, China, a multidimensional indicator system incorporating traffic-flow characteristics, road infrastructure, land-use structure, traffic management measures, meteorological conditions, and spatiotemporal dynamic features was constructed. Pearson correlation, Spearman correlation, and Distance Correlation were jointly employed to identify linear, monotonic, and nonlinear interactions between congestion and its driving factors. Subsequently, machine-learning models were developed to characterize congestion dynamics, while SHapley Additive exPlanations (SHAP) were used to quantify the contribution of individual factors and reveal hidden system mechanisms.The results reveal three distinct response regimes underlying congestion evolution: instantaneous responses dominated by traffic-flow variables, transient responses associated with traffic disturbances, and cumulative responses driven by land-use and demographic characteristics. The evolution from free-flow to severe congestion exhibits clear nonlinear state-transition behavior, accompanied by strong positive feedback between traffic volume, vehicle speed, congestion duration, and congestion extent. Furthermore, explainable artificial intelligence identifies average vehicle speed, traffic volume, congestion length, and congestion duration as the dominant variables governing congestion evolution.These findings provide new insights into the self-organizing nature of urban congestion and demonstrate the potential of explainable artificial intelligence for revealing hidden dynamics in complex urban systems.​

AI.tldr: 本研究提出可解释机器学习框架，利用贵阳市多源数据揭示城市交通拥堵的非线性演化机制，识别出三种响应模式（瞬时、瞬态、累积）及关键驱动变量。
AI.research_question: 城市交通拥堵的形成与状态转换的非线性演化机制是什么？如何从复杂系统视角统一理解拥堵动态？
AI.motivation: 现有研究主要聚焦拥堵预测，但对拥堵形成和状态转换的非线性演化机制理解不足，缺乏从复杂系统视角对拥堵动态的统一认识。
AI.theoretical_framework: 复杂系统理论、非线性动力学、自组织理论；结合可解释人工智能（SHAP）方法揭示隐藏系统机制。
AI.method: 利用贵阳市多源城市数据构建多维指标系统（交通流、道路基础设施、土地利用、交通管理、气象、时空动态特征）；联合使用Pearson、Spearman和距离相关分析识别线性/单调/非线性交互；机器学习模型建模拥堵动态；SHAP量化因素贡献。
AI.findings: 三种响应机制：瞬时响应（交通流变量主导）、瞬态响应（交通扰动相关）、累积响应（土地利用与人口特征驱动）；自由流到严重拥堵呈现非线性状态转换，伴随交通量、车速、拥堵时长与范围之间的强正反馈；平均车速、交通量、拥堵长度和拥堵时长是关键变量。
AI.theory_contributions: 揭示了城市拥堵的自组织本质和三种响应模式（瞬时/瞬态/累积）；发现了拥堵演化的非线性状态转换行为及正反馈机制；展示了可解释人工智能在揭示复杂城市系统隐藏动态中的潜力。
AI.practical_contributions: 为城市交通管理提供拥堵演化的关键驱动变量识别，支持精准干预策略制定；有助于改善交通规划、信号控制和拥堵预警系统设计。
